newsitem.title: USA: Sabratek says underwriters exercise option.
newsitem.headline: Sabratek says underwriters exercise option.

text.p: Sabratek Corp said Thursday the underwriters of its recently completed public offer of 1.1 million common shares exercised an overallotment option for an additional 191,486 shares at $18 each.
Sabratek said the gross proceeds from the offer were about $23.2 million, excluding the overallotment option. The company now has about 9.7 million shares in public hands.
Sabratek develops and markets interactive therapeutic and diagnostic medical systems for the alternative-site health care market.
Its shares were off 1/2 Thursday at 22-3/4.
